verdict.rationale: Brave ships its own AI-generated output. The Answers endpoint gives grounded AI answers with citations, a deep-research mode and streaming. The summarizer produces AI summaries of search results, and there are LLM-generated POI descriptions and intelligent query suggestions. All of these work over Brave's web index rather than the user's own data, and they come via API rather than as in-product insights. Missing for 10: AI insights over user-supplied or private data, an in-product (dashboard) insights experience, and independent hands-on corroboration of answer quality.
